item.title: Hannah Bilka, Anna Wilgren score in shootout to give Seattle Torrent 3-2 win over Sceptres
item.description: Hannah Bilka and Anna Wilgren scored in a shootout to lift the Seattle Torrent to a 3-2 victory over the Toronto Sceptres on Saturday.

item.title: 'No War on Venezuela' protests pop up around WA following US strikes
item.description: Protestors and residents gathered in Seattle in reaction to news of the United States launching a military operation in Venezuela. We spoke with the attendees on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Coastal Flooding Possible on Sunday
item.description: Breezy & wet on Sunday with mountain snow. As many folks head back to work and school after the long holiday break, the week will start soggy with slightly less rain forecast by the end of the week.

item.title: Live Seahawks-49ers scores, updates: Seahawks clinch No. 1 seed with 13-3 win over 49ers
item.description: Get the latest Seattle Seahawks scores, game stats, updates and more for the Week 18 matchup with the San Francisco 49ers with the top-seed in the NFC on the line.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks secure No. 1 seed in NFC and division title with dominant 13-3 win over 49ers
item.description: Zach Charbonnet scored on a 27-yard run in the first quarter and Seattle shut down the high-powered San Francisco offense in a 13-3 victory over the 49ers that secured the No. 1 seed in the NFC.

item.title: Takeaways from Seattle Seahawks 13-3 win over 49ers to clinch No. 1 seed
item.description: A 10-point victory may never look more dominant than Saturday night's 13-3 victory for the Seattle Seahawks over the San Francisco 49ers.

item.title: Some WA leaders applaud, others condemn US military operation in Venezuela
item.description: Leaders across Washington have registered both their support and condemnations of the Trump administration's military operation in Venezuela.

item.title: Rounds of sloppy, breezy weather in Seattle
item.description: At times today, there could be torrential rain, isolated lightning strikes, breezy weather, small hail and occasional mountain snow.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks reach four-year extension with left tackle Charles Cross
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks have reached a deal on a four-year contract extension with left tackle Charles Cross, a source confirmed to FOX 13 Seattle on Sunday.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Heavy Mountain Snow this Week
item.description: Tuesday- Thursday will be the wettest days this week with moderate to heavy downpours possible at times. Mornings will be chilly by midweek, with the possibility of “chunky rain” in the foothills.
